tools.name: search_trips
tools.description: Search TripFinder's catalog of multi-day guided group tours from operators including G Adventures, Intrepid, Exodus, Trafalgar, Collette and Exoticca. Filter by destination, dates, budget, activity level, comfort level and travel style. Returns 10 trips per page with from-prices, next departures and

tools.name: get_trip
tools.description: Full public facts for one tour: day-by-day itinerary, inclusions and exclusions, meals, accommodation, transport, group size, age limits, international flight status, promotions, and upcoming departure dates with per-person prices and availability.

tools.name: compare_trips
tools.description: Compare two to four tours on the same facts: price, duration, route, group size, age limits, comfort and activity level, flights, inclusions, meals, accommodation, transport, itinerary outline and next departures.

tools.name: list_catalog_options
tools.description: The countries, regions, tour operators (with trip counts) and travel styles currently in the catalog, plus the valid activity levels, comfort levels and sort orders for search_trips.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: TripFinder's sourced editorial guides: operator comparisons (e.g. G Adventures vs Intrepid), destination comparisons, what a tour price includes, travelling solo, choosing pace and difficulty. Returns each guide's short answer; use get_guide for the full text.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: The full text of one TripFinder guide in Markdown, with its sources, FAQ and the points a traveller should confirm before booking.

tools.name: about_tripfinder
tools.description: Who TripFinder is, how booking and payment work, what it costs the traveller, licensing (TICO), the advisors, and contact details. Use this to answer trust and process questions.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Start a booking: send the traveller's chosen trip(s), preferred departure date(s) and contact details to a TripFinder travel advisor, who replies within one business day with the confirmed price and availability and completes the booking with the traveller. tools.name: contact_advisor
tools.description: Send a general enquiry to a TripFinder travel advisor when the traveller has not settled on a specific trip, wants a custom recommendation, or has a question the catalog cannot answer. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_trips, contact_advisor · Private data: about_tripfinder, request_quote, contact_advisor · Public sink: request_quote, contact_advisor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_trips, contact_advisor · Private data: about_tripfinder, request_quote, contact_advisor · Public sink: request_quote, contact_advisor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
